interpretation: The six mathematical/method checks are accepted only for the declared local one-injection finite-precision model. Primary closest-work review is incomplete, so this is not originality qualification, scientific admission or selection. No code, test, scorer or experiment was executed.

formal_object.rationale: Dimensions and transition order are consistent. The card now separates transition F_t from causal information, uses an explicit prefix-only SPD metric predictor, discloses conditional-covariance collapse when exact state is known, requires B>=d b_min, and limits the theorem to one quantization injection.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: For SPD C, T=C^(1/2)U gives T^-1 C T^-T=I and T^T O T=Lambda. The time-varying recurrence uses the required ordered T_t^-1 F_t T_(t-1), transforms both injection and read, and keeps the frozen-future/Jacobian boundary explicit.

derivation.rationale: The trace-risk identity and continuous KKT water-filling are correct under subtractive-dither assumptions. The revision handles B>=d b_min, active sets, zero eigenvalues, separate integer allocation and b_min<=3 in the exact 2D example. Repeated-injection risk is not claimed.

assumptions.rationale: Equal calibrated row ranges, no overload, independent subtractive dither, SPD retained support, basis alignment, T conditioning, metadata, clipping and cross-injection exclusions are explicit. Deterministic rounding and global semantic/CE guarantees are not imported.

method_expression.rationale: The corrected bytes form a pre-current-quantization candidate from the already quantized prior representation. C_theta and O_theta have PSD parameterizations, fixed-reference stopped targets X/Y, prefix sampling, explicit lambda_C/lambda_O Frobenius losses and predictor-only gradients; the causal EMA is correctly a different estimator. CE, post-training quantization and optional QAT remain separated.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: The prediction concerns matched local quadratic output disturbance only. Anisotropic gain, isotropic disappearance, stale-metric reversal, static/per-channel baselines and full metadata/kernel cost form legitimate conditional predictions and falsifiers.

closest_alternative.rationale: D05 is distinct from D03, Q-Delta and rejected residual error feedback at the stated level, but balanced realization, transform/rate-distortion coding, rotation/static scaling and recurrent-state quantization lack complete primary formula/code audit. The source-scope note is an honest boundary, not collision clearance.

unresolved_conditions: The theorem does not cover accumulated recurrent quantization, clipping, basis-estimation error or CE benefit.
Dense/block kernels, metadata and RTX2080Ti feasibility remain unmeasured.
reviewed_execution: Exact-byte mathematical and semantic review only; no project execution.
